# JCM v2.3.0-prerelease.2 for MTR 4.0.5 has been released!

This is a prerelease, focused on bug-fixes and preparation before the official release.

## General
### MTR Patch
- Attempt to fix the "infamous" BVE Motor Sound bug in MTR 4, where an unrendered vehicle would result in the sound getting stuck.

## Technical

### Scripting
- **PIDS Scripting - The newly added "Rectangle" has been renamed to "Rect"**
  - This is to avoid name conflict of existing scripts using  AWT's Rectangle.
- Add `Resources.ANTE_FLAG` so scripts do not error out, though it is set to false.
- Add basic compat for `SoundHelper`/`TickableSound` in ANTE.
- Added the dummy `Resources.mgr()` alias that previously existed in NTE.
- Add `Resources.id(id: Identifier, suffix: String)` to obtain a new identifier with `suffix` being appended to the path.
  - Can be used with a "base path" via `idr()`, then resolving it in runtime with this function.
- If you invoke a Java method with an "undefined" as one of its parameter, it will show a very long `Can't find method...` error, since it cannot match the method signature.
  - The Rhino Undefined class will now be replaced with `UNDEFINED` in the error message, instead of the full class name.
  - An extra warning will be shown in console, notifying that you have passed an undefined object as one of its param.
- Fix `ConcurrentModificationException` when reading resources during Runtime Stage in previous beta release.

## Translations
Thanks to the following people who have contributed translations for this release! (No particular order):
- Paaaaddy (ga_ie)

Translations for JCM is now hosted on [ZiYue's Weblate](https://weblate.ziyuesinicization.site/projects/joban-client-mod/)

You can download this release on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/jcm), [CurseForge](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jcm) or [GitHub](https://github.com/DistrictOfJoban/Joban-Client-Mod/releases)

# JCM v2.3.0-prerelease.1 for MTR 4.0.5 has been released!

> This release contains breaking changes to JCM's internal codebase. Common addons have been tested against, however some addon depending on JCM may break. 
 
This is a prerelease, some QOL changes for scripting has been introduced.

## General
- Fix Forge crashing on launch

## Technical

### Scripting
- Compiled scripts are now re-used during parsing stage, which may improve loading time during parsing time for large packs.
- When passing in JS objects in `print()` or `console` functions, they will now output the corresponding JSON string instead of `[object Object]`.
- When encountering a runtime error, only the JS stacktrace will be logged in the console to reduce clutter.
- For convenience, all non-deprecated methods with an `Identifier` argument now also has a corresponding `String` variant. Thus you can pass in a string like `"mtr:font"` instead of wrapping it with `Resources.id()`.
  - For `Resources.idr()`, simply prepend your string with `./`.
  - Note: Relative path can still only be used during parsing stage.
- `StateTracker.setState()` now returns a boolean on whether the state is changed or not, instead of needing a separate check.
- Added the `Java` util class
  - Allows creation of native java array via `Java.newArray`, or converting from a list `Java.toArray`
  - A global `asJavaArray` function is added for interoperability with ANTE. However scripts targeting JCM should use `Java.toArray` instead.
- Slightly improved ANTE backward compatibility support, including read-only custom config.

## Translations

Translations for JCM is now hosted on [ZiYue's Weblate](https://weblate.ziyuesinicization.site/projects/joban-client-mod/)

**Download:**  
You can download this release on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/jcm), [CurseForge](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jcm) or [GitHub](https://github.com/DistrictOfJoban/Joban-Client-Mod/releases)

# JCM v2.3.0-beta.3 for MTR 4.0.5 has been released!

> **Beta Notice**
> 
> This is a beta release and is not recommended for stable deployment, nor is it intended for normal players to use. Please report any mod behaviors you feel could be improved.
> 
> Feature/implementation details may change throughout the beta lifecycle, any content you have made for this beta release may or may not break in the next version.


> This release contains breaking changes to JCM's internal codebase. Common addons have been tested against, however some addon depending on JCM may break.

## General
### Blocks
- Fix: Wall-attached blocks may now be attached to the backside of stairs, which is fully solid.

## Technical

### Scripting
- Perf Fix: Skip executing scripts during shadow render pass. (BugQuantumCore)
  - Some misc refactoring is also made to reduce performance impact of non-scripted elements.
- Add `MinecraftClient.getCameraMode()` to return the perspective of the player's camera. (F5)
- Add `GraphicsTexture.fullAA()` and `GraphicsTexture.noAA()` for configuring anti-aliasing behaviour.
- Add light parameter overload for `RenderManager.drawModel()`, for rendering a model with a particular light.
  - light value can be obtained via the newly added `MinecraftClient.lightAt(pos: Vector3f)`, which returns an integer value consisted of both the block & sky light level.
- Add the `rateLimit` property to script entries, which applies a global rate limit per-instance.
- Script instance whose execution time took more than 5s is now enlisted as **(Not Responding...)** in the Script Debug Overlay.
- Script that entered a loop spanning more than 10 seconds will now get aborted, for recovery from infinite loop.
- In-game script parsing error now contains the exception message when hovering over it, instead of requiring to view it in the Console.
- Fix `VanillaText.withHoverText()` using an erroneous type (MutableText instead of VanillaText) as its argument. Now it should behave according to the docs.

## Translations
Thanks to the following people who have contributed translations for this release! (No particular order):
- DelphoxOTS (ja_jp)
- Smile-Wood (zh_cn)
- Paaaaddy (ga_ie)

Translations for JCM is now hosted on [ZiYue's Weblate](https://weblate.ziyuesinicization.site/projects/joban-client-mod/)

**Download:**  
You can download this release on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/jcm), [CurseForge](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jcm) or [GitHub](https://github.com/DistrictOfJoban/Joban-Client-Mod/releases)

# JCM v2.3.0-beta.2 for MTR 4.0.5 has been released!

> **Beta Notice**
> 
> This is a beta release and is not recommended for stable deployment, nor is it intended for normal players to use. Please report any mod behaviors you feel could be improved.
> 
> Feature/implementation details may change throughout the beta lifecycle, any content you have made for this beta release may or may not break in the next version.


> This release contains breaking changes to JCM's internal codebase. Common addons have been tested against, however some addon depending on JCM may break.
 
This is an interim beta release.

## General
### MTR Patch
- (Fabric-only) Preserves rail preview of long-running rail (i.e. Outside the render distance), instead of disappearing.
- For MTR's multi-item selection screen, you can now hold `Shift` to exclusively select one item, instead of needing to add the new item then removing the existing item.
- **Introduce experimental Frustum culling**
  - MTR 4 uses occlusion culling, which would perform tracing to check whether elements behind terrains are visible from the player's position.
  - This update adds Frustum Culling as another layer on top of Occlusion Culling, which simply checks whether the elements are within the camera bound at all. Therefore if you aren't looking at the element, it will skip being rendered. (Scripts will continue to be invoked just like Occlusion Culling.)
  - If you see any visual artifacts caused by this, please report.
- Re-add camera-lowering feature from MTR 3 by sneaking. (Previously branded as "sitting")
  - May be turned off in JCM Settings (Revert to MTR 4 behaviour)

## Technical

### General
- Add `MinecraftClient.getCameraMode()` to return the perspective of the player's camera. (F5)
- Add light parameter overload for `RenderManager.drawModel()`, for rendering a model with a particular light.
  - light value can be obtained via the newly added `MinecraftClient.lightAt(pos: Vector3f)`, which returns an integer value consisted of both the block & sky light level.

### Vehicle Scripting
- Add `VehicleWrapper.isDoorOpenable()` and `VehicleWrapper.isDoorOpen()`, given the car number and a position relative to the center of the car.

### Lift Scripting
- Fix `isScriptRendered` not allowing player to board the lift.
- Rename `isScriptRendered` to `isScriptControlled`
- Add `LiftWrapper.isDoorway1Openable()`, `LiftWrapper.isDoorway2Openable()`, `LiftWrapper.isDoorway1Open()` and `LiftWrapper.isDoorway2Open()` for checking open doorways.

### Eyecandy Scripting
- Rename `isScriptRendered` to `isScriptControlled`
- Add `EyecandyWrapper.facingAngle()`, which returns the block facing angle directly.
  - Please use this instead of relying on `EyecandyWrapper.facing().asRotation()`, which will no longer work in MTR 4.1.

## Translations
Thanks to the following people who have contributed translations for this release! (No particular order):
- BugQuantumCore & Mewzica (zh_cn)
- DelphoxOTS (ja_jp)
- Fed (it_it)

Translations for JCM is now hosted on [ZiYue's Weblate](https://weblate.ziyuesinicization.site/projects/joban-client-mod/)

**Download:**  
You can download this release on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/jcm), [CurseForge](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jcm) or [GitHub](https://github.com/DistrictOfJoban/Joban-Client-Mod/releases)

# JCM v2.3.0-beta.1 for MTR 4.0.5 has been released!

> **Beta Notice**
> 
> This is a beta release and is not recommended for stable deployment, nor is it intended for normal players to use. Please report any mod behaviors you feel could be improved.
> 
> Feature/implementation details may change throughout the beta lifecycle, any content you have made for this beta release may or may not break in the next version.


> This release contains breaking changes to JCM's internal codebase. Common addons have been tested against, however some addon depending on JCM may break.


## General
### New Blocks
- Add **Emergency Train Stop Button (Wall mounted, TML)** and **URL variant** (Thanks **LX9702**!)

### Slab Support for blocks
- The **Spot Lamp** block in JCM will now descend/ascend in accordance to slab blocks attached.
- The **Railway Sign Poles** in MTR now gained the ability to extend the pole according to the slab above.

### Fixes
- Fix JCM having an overly-long keybinding description, causing the Minecraft keybind page to shift outside the game window.
- Previously **Spot Lamp** will always prefer attaching to the top block if available. 
  - Now it will respect attaching to the side the player clicked on.
- **PIDS Projector** can now render further away before disappearing.
- Fix **Automatic Iron Door** detecting players in spectator mode as well.
- The playing mechanism for **Sound Looper** has been revised.
  - In JCM v1, the sounds are played to everyone across the server, which makes it a reliable source for playing all sorts of audio.
  - In JCM v2, it would only play to nearby players. Which means player may not be able to hear anything after getting in-range, until another loop occurs.
  - In this update, the range is now changed dynamically based on the duration. This allows short-form looping audio to play for nearby players, while having further range for long-form audio.
    - This should hopefully make sound looper more reliable.

## Technical

### PIDS Projector UI Improvement
It now supports real-time position/rotation preview, and you may now type the negative sign (-) as the first character.

### Railway Sign Text Coloring
Allow coloring text with the `textColor` field in the mtr_custom_resources.json "sign" section. Format is the same as `backgroundColor`.

### Lift Scripting
Lift Scripting has been added for review and feedback by the public, including rendering and sound playing.

See [JCM Docs](https://jcm.joban.org/v2.3/dev/scripting/type/lift/) for documentation.

### PIDS Scripting
- Add `TextWrapper.measureWidth()` to return the actual text width. Note that this cannot be chained for further usage, and must be invoked separately.
- Add `PIDSWrapper.isPlatformAutoDetected()`, returning whether the selected PIDS platform is manually picked by the user, or if it's automatically detected.
- Add `RectangleWrapper`, which is similar to `TextureWrapper` with the texture id pointing to `mtr:textures/block/white.png`
  - PIDS relying on a white texture previously should change to use `RectangleWrapper` (`Rectangle.`), as it is guaranteed the output will be a solid color, even if such texture is moved/no longer available in future Minecraft/MTR versions.

### General Scripting
#### API-related
- `Vector3f` now accepts TSC's `Position` class as a constructor
- Added the `ctx.setDebugInfo(value: any)` shorthand for temporary, single-value on-screen debug info, without requiring a key.
  - Same as calling `ctx.setDebugInfo("<Untitled>", value)` if called once.
  - Subsequent invocation will result in `<Untitled2>`, `<Untitled3>` and so on...
- Added `PlayerEntity.displayName()` to return the player's name with team prefixes.
- Added `PlayerEntity.isSpectator()` and `PlayerEntity.isCreative()`
- Added `MinecraftClientWrapper.getCurrentWorldId()` and `MinecraftClientWrapper.getWorldBlockState()`, allowing for better environmental context.
- Added the `MTRWrapper` class (Referenced using `MTR` in scripts).

...

# JCM v2.1.2 for MTR 4.0.3 has been released!

## New
- **Scripting**
- - Add script quick reload, allowing reloading script without reloading the entire resource pack.
- - - JCM Debug Mode must be enabled before using.
- - - Shift+R: Reload JCM Scripts
- - - Ctrl+R: Reload MTR Scripts

## Fixes
- **Scripting**
- - Add `java.text.*` package to whitelist, allowing `AttributedString` to be used on AWT Graphics-based PIDS.
- - Fix internal timer possibly rolling into the negatives after rejoining world, causing script with `RateLimit` to not work properly for a short while.
- Fix breaking incomplete/broken multipart block crashing the game.

**Download:**  
You can download this release on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/jcm), [CurseForge](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jcm) or [GitHub](https://github.com/DistrictOfJoban/Joban-Client-Mod/releases)
